title: Immutable application store with ledger refresh

claims.text: createStore freezes state with immutable and publishes patches by cloning, so every refresh, route, selection and expanded change produces a new frozen AppState.
refresh validates tools with validateTools, pages events with validatePage, and throws invalidResponse on a second resync or on out-of-order, duplicate or non-advancing cursors.
refresh merges paged events into a staged ledger keyed by id and lamport, deduplicating identical events by canonical comparison and rejecting conflicting ones.
A failed refresh publishes phase error with stale true when a head exists, keeps the prior events, and surfaces domain refusals distinctly from transport failures.

decision.rule: Change here when store immutability, ledger paging validation, duplicate event merging or error publication needs to change.
decision.failure: Refresh accepts a non-advancing cursor, a conflicting duplicate event merges silently, or a failed refresh drops the prior head.

questions.q: Where does refresh reject a second resync from the transport?
Where should I change how duplicate ledger events are merged by id and lamport?
Where can I debug why a refresh ends in stale error state?
How does the store keep state immutable across patches?
